name: Obsidian Sync
description: Keeps Obsidian in your Ambxst colours: writes an "ambxst" CSS snippet in each vault on every theme change, which open Obsidian windows pick up at once. Can also switch Obsidian between dark and light with the Ambxst palette.
author: Ecta250
permissions: Writes .obsidian/snippets/ambxst.css in the Obsidian vaults it finds (from obsidian.json, native and Flatpak) on every theme change
Edits .obsidian/appearance.json in those vaults: turns the snippet on once, and with Match dark/light sets the base theme
